name: One-Page Website
description: One tidy page with everything a new or small business needs to be found and contacted.
pageIntro: A one-page website is the quickest way to get your business online properly. Everything people need sits on a single, scrolling page: who you are, what you offer, where to find you and how to get in touch.
whoItsFor: New businesses, side businesses, seasonal businesses and anyone who needs a clean, professional presence without lots of pages to look after.

details.heading: What's on the page
details.text: A welcoming introduction, your services or products, a short about section, opening hours or service area, and a contact form. We'll pick the sections that fit your business best.

details.heading: How it works
details.text:
We start with a short chat about your business. I design the page, you tell me what to change, then I build it, test it on phones and computers, and put it live on your domain.

You'll usually be online in about a week.
